title: Cameroon NDC 3.0 / *Contribution Déterminée au Niveau National Actualisée*
methodology: Government policy synthesizing prior vulnerability/projection evidence
limitations: Climate projections in adaptation section partly reproduce earlier NDC/vulnerability evidence and do not identify model/scenario there. (UNFCCC)

title: Plan National d’Adaptation aux Changements Climatiques du Cameroun - official hosting page
methodology: Official ministry page linking the PNACC
limitations: Publication page accessible; underlying PNACC attachment was not successfully parsed in this research session, so no substantive claim below relies on its contents. (Minepded)

title: *Request for an Arrangement under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility*, Country Report 24/53
methodology: IMF staff assessment, government discussions, World Bank assessment input
limitations: Climate-FCV effects are expert synthesis/prospective risks rather than causal estimates. (IMF)

title: Cameroon data portal
geographic_coverage: National with separate Far North and NW/SW categories
methodology: Government, UNHCR, IOM and OCHA compiled displacement estimates
limitations: Composite sources and methodologies; IDP values are estimates and differ by source. (UNHCR Data Portal)

title: *Japan boosts life-saving food assistance as funding crisis threatens 600,000 people in Cameroon*
methodology: WFP food-security and operational planning evidence
limitations: Agency operational source; food insecurity is explicitly multi-causal; announced assistance is not evidence of effectiveness. (World Food Programme)

title: *Climate-fueled Violence and Displacement in the Lake Chad Basin: Focus on Chad and Cameroon*
geographic_coverage: Far North/Logone Birni; Lake Chad Basin
methodology: Interviews with Cameroonian refugees, authorities, UN/donors/NGOs plus Cameroon-focused phone interviews
limitations: Advocacy source; interview/perception evidence; fieldwork mainly conducted in Chad; no causal counterfactual. (Refugees International)

title: *Implications of Climatic Stressors on Agro-Pastoral Resources Among Mbororo Communities Along the Slopes of Kilum-Ijim Mountain, North West Region, Cameroon*
methodology: 350 randomly administered household questionnaires, interviews and quantitative/qualitative analysis
limitations: Very local; “environmental stressors” combine climatic and non-climatic factors; observational design. (Frontiers)

title: *Youth Agropastoral Entrepreneurship Promotion Programme (AEP-Youth): Impact Assessment Report*
methodology: Non-experimental counterfactual; propensity-score/multistage matching; quantitative surveys + KIIs
limitations: Programme applicants formed sampling frame; no clean treated/control village designation; only four regions. (IFAD)

title: *Project Completion Report Validation - Commodity Value Chain Support Project (PADFA)*
methodology: Independent validation of PCR and supporting evidence
limitations: M&E system itself was weak/non-operational, materially restricting attribution. (IOE)

title: *Country programme document for Cameroon (2027-2031)*
methodology: National statistics, UN evidence and prior Independent Country Programme Evaluation
limitations: Some programme achievements are summarized from the underlying ICPE rather than independently re-evaluated in the CPD. (UNDP)

title: *Joint Monitoring Mission Report: CSO-Led Peacebuilding Project in the Lake Chad Basin Sub-Region - Cameroon and Niger*
methodology: Joint visits/interviews with implementers, beneficiaries, authorities and CSOs
limitations: Not independent; beneficiaries and implementers are part of monitoring process; no counterfactual. (MPTF Gateway)

title: *Implementation Completion and Results Report: Cameroon Inclusive and Resilient Cities Development Project (P156210)*
geographic_coverage: Douala, Yaoundé, Kumba, Ngaoundéré, Batouri, Maroua, Kousséri
methodology: Project M&E, reports, databases, field missions and beneficiary/stakeholder evidence
limitations: Formal satisfaction survey absent; some ex-post analysis used ex-ante benefit assumptions; NBS component incomplete. (World Bank)
